name: careeros
description: Fadi — an AI operating system for a person's career (monorepo).

scripts.db:reset: docker compose -f infrastructure/docker/docker-compose.yml down --volumes && docker compose -f infrastructure/docker/docker-compose.yml up -d postgres && npm run db:migrate
scripts.dev: npm run services:up || true && npm --workspace @careeros/web run dev
scripts.services:down: docker compose -f infrastructure/docker/docker-compose.yml stop postgres searxng speaches kokoro
scripts.services:up: docker compose -f infrastructure/docker/docker-compose.yml up -d postgres searxng speaches kokoro && node scripts/voice-models.mjs
scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace @careeros/database run typecheck && npm --workspace @careeros/web run typecheck
scripts.voice:up: docker compose -f infrastructure/docker/docker-compose.yml up -d speaches kokoro && node scripts/voice-models.mjs
